en.sayed-ali-raza: the cultivators [1] (dahāqīn, plural of dīhqān) of your city have complained of your strictness, hard heartedness, humiliating treatment and harshness.
I thought over it and found that since they are unbelievers they cannot be brought near nor kept away or treated severely because of the pledge with them.
Behave with them in between strictness and softness and adopt for them a mingling or remoteness and aloofness with nearness and closeness if Allāh so wills.
